instructions: Lay the bacon in a large skillet with little overlap, then turn the heat to medium.
Cook the bacon for 10 to 12 minutes, turning every 2 to 3 minutes, until it's browned and crisp.
Move the bacon to a plate lined with paper towels. Leave the drippings in the pan and keep the heat on medium.
Crack 4 of the eggs into the hot drippings, spaced apart. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the edges of the whites start to set.
Flip the eggs and cook the other side for 30 seconds for a runny yolk, or 1 to 2 minutes for a set yolk. Move them to plates and cook the other 4 eggs the same way.
Grind the pepper over the eggs. Serve the eggs with the bacon.
method_notes: The Pork Checkoff's classic bacon and eggs is the lead (bacon first, eggs in the drippings, flip once). It has no ratings. Just A Pinch and Meal Garden agree on frying the eggs in the bacon fat. Honest time is about 25 minutes for 8 eggs because they go in two batches, which is over the list's 15 minutes. A second skillet for the eggs would bring it down a little.
